      # or inline before each method, depending on configuration.
      # EnforcedStyle config covers only method definitions.
      # Applications of visibility methods to symbols can be controlled
      # using AllowModifiersOnSymbols config.
      # Also, the visibility of `attr*` methods can be controlled using
      # AllowModifiersOnAttrs config.
      #
      # In Ruby 3.0, `attr*` methods now return an array of defined method names
      # as symbols. So we can write the modifier and `attr*` in inline style.
      # AllowModifiersOnAttrs config allows `attr*` methods to be written in
      # inline style without modifying applications that have been maintained
      # for a long time in group style. Furthermore, developers who are not very
      # familiar with Ruby may know that the modifier applies to `def`, but they
      # may not know that it also applies to `attr*` methods. It would be easier
      # to understand if we could write `attr*` methods in inline style.

      #   Autocorrection is not safe, because the visibility of dynamically
      #   defined methods can vary depending on the state determined by
      #   the group access modifier.

      #   class Foo
      #
      #     private def bar; end
      #     private def baz; end
      #
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   class Foo
      #
      #     private
      #
      #     def bar; end
      #     def baz; end
      #
      #   end
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: inline
      #   # bad
      #   class Foo
      #
      #     private
      #
      #     def bar; end
      #     def baz; end
      #

      #

      #

      #     private *METHOD_NAMES
      #     private *private_methods
      #
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowModifiersOnSymbols: false
      #   # bad
      #   class Foo
      #
      #     private :bar, :baz
      #     private *%i[qux quux]
      #     private *METHOD_NAMES
      #     private *private_methods
      #
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowModifiersOnAttrs: true (default)
      #   # good
      #   class Foo
      #
      #     public attr_reader :bar
      #     protected attr_writer :baz
      #     private attr_accessor :qux
      #     private attr :quux
      #
      #     def public_method; end
      #
      #     private
      #
      #     def private_method; end
      #
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowModifiersOnAttrs: false
      #   # bad
      #   class Foo
      #
      #     public attr_reader :bar
      #     protected attr_writer :baz
      #     private attr_accessor :qux
      #     private attr :quux
      #
      #   end
      class AccessModifierDeclarations < Base
        extend AutoCorrector

        include ConfigurableEnforcedStyle
        include RangeHelp

        GROUP_STYLE_MESSAGE = [
          '`%<access_modifier>s` should not be',
          'inlined in method definitions.'
        ].join(' ')

        INLINE_STYLE_MESSAGE = [
          '`%<access_modifier>s` should be',
          'inlined in method definitions.'
        ].join(' ')

        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[private protected public module_function].freeze

        ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES = %i[pair block].freeze

        # @!method access_modifier_with_symbol?(node)
        def_node_matcher :access_modifier_with_symbol?, <<~PATTERN
          (send nil? {:private :protected :public :module_function}
            {(sym _)+ (splat {#percent_symbol_array? const send})}
          )
        PATTERN

        # @!method access_modifier_with_attr?(node)
        def_node_matcher :access_modifier_with_attr?, <<~PATTERN
          (send nil? {:private :protected :public :module_function}
            (send nil? {:attr :attr_reader :attr_writer :attr_accessor} _+))
        PATTERN

        def on_send(node)
          return if allowed?(node)

          badge = self.class.badge
          department_name = badge.department_name
          cop_identifier = badge.to_s
          department_lookup_key = department_name
          department_configuration = nil
          if department_lookup_key
            department_configuration = @config[department_lookup_key]
          end
          cop_specific_configuration = @config.for_cop(cop_identifier)
          merged_configuration = {}
          if department_configuration
            department_configuration.each do |config_key, config_value|
              merged_configuration[config_key] = config_value
            end
          end
          cop_specific_configuration.each do |config_key, config_value|
            merged_configuration[config_key] = config_value
          end
          cop_configuration = merged_configuration

          enforced_style_value = cop_configuration['EnforcedStyle']
          style_name = enforced_style_value.to_sym
          supported_styles_key = Util.to_supported_styles('EnforcedStyle')
          raw_supported_styles = cop_configuration[supported_styles_key]
          supported_style_names = []
          raw_supported_styles.each do |raw_style|
            converted_style = raw_style.to_sym
            supported_style_names << converted_style
          end
          style_supported = supported_style_names.include?(style_name)
          raise "Unknown style #{style_name} selected!" unless style_supported

          group_style_enabled = style_name == :group
          inline_style_enabled = style_name == :inline
          modifier_name = node.method_name
          selector_range = node.loc.selector
          parent_node = node.parent
          argument_nodes = node.arguments
          sibling_nodes = node.right_siblings
          argument_count = argument_nodes.size

          inlined_modifier = false
          symbol_arguments = []
          splat_arguments = []
          def_arguments = []
          send_arguments = []
          other_arguments = []
          percent_symbol_splat = false
          constant_splat = false
          send_splat = false
          symbol_argument_count = 0
          splat_argument_count = 0
          def_argument_count = 0
          send_argument_count = 0
          other_argument_count = 0

          argument_nodes.each do |argument|
            if argument.sym_type?
              symbol_arguments << argument
              symbol_argument_count += 1
            elsif argument.splat_type?
              splat_arguments << argument
              splat_argument_count += 1
              splat_children = argument.children
              splat_value = splat_children.first
              percent_array = splat_value && splat_value.array_type? && splat_value.percent_literal?(:symbol)
              constant_value = splat_value && splat_value.const_type?
              send_value = splat_value && splat_value.send_type?
              if percent_array
                percent_symbol_splat = true
              elsif constant_value
                constant_splat = true
              elsif send_value
                send_splat = true
              else
                other_arguments << argument
                other_argument_count += 1
              end
            elsif argument.def_type? || argument.defs_type?
              def_arguments << argument
              def_argument_count += 1
            elsif argument.send_type?
              send_arguments << argument
              send_argument_count += 1
            else
              other_arguments << argument
              other_argument_count += 1
            end
          end
          inlined_modifier = argument_count.positive?

          no_splat_arguments = splat_argument_count.zero?
          no_def_arguments = def_argument_count.zero?
          no_send_arguments = send_argument_count.zero?
          no_other_arguments = other_argument_count.zero?
          has_symbol_arguments = !symbol_argument_count.zero?
          only_symbol_arguments = no_splat_arguments &&
                                  no_def_arguments &&
                                  no_send_arguments &&
                                  no_other_arguments &&
                                  has_symbol_arguments
          single_splat_argument = splat_argument_count == 1
          no_symbol_arguments = symbol_argument_count.zero?
          allowed_splat_child = percent_symbol_splat || constant_splat || send_splat
          only_allowed_splat = no_symbol_arguments &&
                               no_def_arguments &&
                               no_send_arguments &&
                               single_splat_argument &&
                               allowed_splat_child
          symbol_modifier = inlined_modifier && (only_symbol_arguments || only_allowed_splat)

          collected_method_names = []
          symbol_arguments.each do |symbol_node|
            responds_to_value = symbol_node.respond_to?(:value)
            raw_symbol_value = symbol_node.value if responds_to_value
            usable_symbol_value = responds_to_value && raw_symbol_value
            collected_method_names << usable_symbol_value if usable_symbol_value
          end
          collected_name_count = collected_method_names.size

          corresponding_defs = []
          if symbol_modifier
            matched_defs = []
            parent_def_nodes = []
            parent_node.each_child_node(:def) do |child|
              parent_def_nodes << child
            end
            parent_def_nodes.each do |child|
              child_method_name = child.method_name
              name_matches = collected_method_names.include?(child_method_name)
              matched_defs << child if name_matches
            end
            matched_def_count = matched_defs.size
            corresponding_defs = matched_defs if matched_def_count == collected_name_count
          else
            first_argument = node.first_argument
            corresponding_defs = [first_argument] if first_argument
          end
          corresponding_def_count = corresponding_defs.size
          has_correctable_defs = corresponding_def_count.positive?

          offense_found = false
          siblings_share_inline = false
          parent_is_conditional = parent_node && parent_node.if_type?

          if group_style_enabled
            if inlined_modifier
              unless parent_is_conditional
                sibling_nodes.each do |sibling|
                  if sibling.send_type?
                    if sibling.method?(modifier_name)
                      unless allowed?(sibling)
                        sibling_arguments = sibling.arguments
                        sibling_inlined = !sibling_arguments.empty?
                        sibling_defs = find_corresponding_def_nodes(sibling)
                        sibling_has_defs = sibling_defs.any?
                        if sibling_inlined && sibling_has_defs
                          siblings_share_inline = true
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
                offense_found = true unless siblings_share_inline
              end
            end
          elsif inline_style_enabled
            offense_found = true unless inlined_modifier
          end

          if offense_found
            add_offense(selector_range) do |corrector|
              if group_style_enabled
                def_nodes = corresponding_defs
                if has_correctable_defs
                  source_parts = []
                  related_comments = processed_source.ast_with_comments[node]
                  related_comments.each do |comment|
                    comment_text = comment.text
                    source_parts << comment_text
                  end
                  def_nodes.each do |def_node|
                    def_source_text = def_node.source
                    source_parts << def_source_text
                  end
                  source = source_parts.join("\n")
                  insertion_prefix = modifier_name.to_s
                  blank_separator = "\n\n"
                  after_existing_modifier = "#{blank_separator}#{source}"
                  before_ancestor_end = "#{insertion_prefix}#{blank_separator}#{source}\n"
                  replacement_text = "#{insertion_prefix}#{blank_separator}#{source}"
                  argument_less_modifier_node = find_argument_less_modifier_node(node)
                  if argument_less_modifier_node
                    corrector.insert_after(argument_less_modifier_node, after_existing_modifier)
                    nodes_to_remove = []
                    def_nodes.each do |def_node|
                      nodes_to_remove << def_node
                    end
                    nodes_to_remove << node
                    remove_nodes(corrector, *nodes_to_remove)
                  else
                    ancestor = nil
                    current_ancestor = node.parent
                    keep_searching = true
                    while current_ancestor && keep_searching
                      ancestor_is_block = current_ancestor.block_type?
                      ancestor_is_class = current_ancestor.class_type?
                      ancestor_is_module = current_ancestor.module_type?
                      if ancestor_is_block || ancestor_is_class || ancestor_is_module
                        ancestor = current_ancestor
                        keep_searching = false
                      else
                        current_ancestor = current_ancestor.parent
                      end
                    end
                    if ancestor
                      ancestor_end = ancestor.loc.end
                      corrector.insert_before(ancestor_end, before_ancestor_end)
                      nodes_to_remove = []
                      def_nodes.each do |def_node|
                        nodes_to_remove << def_node
                      end
                      nodes_to_remove << node
                      remove_nodes(corrector, *nodes_to_remove)
                    else
                      corrector.replace(node, replacement_text)
                    end
                  end
                end
              elsif inline_style_enabled
                remove_nodes(corrector, node)
                grouped_def_nodes = []
                take_following_defs = true
                sibling_nodes.each do |sibling|
                  if take_following_defs
                    sibling_is_send = sibling.send_type?
                    sibling_is_bare_modifier = sibling_is_send && sibling.bare_access_modifier_declaration?
                    sibling_is_def = sibling.def_type?
                    if sibling_is_bare_modifier
                      take_following_defs = false
                    elsif sibling_is_def
                      grouped_def_nodes << sibling
                    end
                  end
                end
                grouped_def_nodes.each do |grouped_def_node|
                  insert_inline_modifier(corrector, grouped_def_node, modifier_name)
                end
              end
            end
            opposite_style_detected
          else
            correct_style_detected
          end
        end
        private

        def allowed?(node)
          !node.access_modifier? ||
            ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES.include?(node.parent&.type) ||
            allow_modifiers_on_symbols?(node) ||
            allow_modifiers_on_attrs?(node)
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, node)
          case style
          when :group
            def_nodes = find_corresponding_def_nodes(node)
            return unless def_nodes.any?

            replace_defs(corrector, node, def_nodes)
          when :inline
            remove_nodes(corrector, node)
            select_grouped_def_nodes(node).each do |grouped_def_node|
              insert_inline_modifier(corrector, grouped_def_node, node.method_name)
            end
          end
        end

        def percent_symbol_array?(node)
          node.array_type? && node.percent_literal?(:symbol)
        end

        def allow_modifiers_on_symbols?(node)
          cop_config['AllowModifiersOnSymbols'] && access_modifier_with_symbol?(node)
        end

        def allow_modifiers_on_attrs?(node)
          cop_config['AllowModifiersOnAttrs'] && access_modifier_with_attr?(node)
        end

        def offense?(node)
          (group_style? && access_modifier_is_inlined?(node) &&
            !node.parent&.if_type? && !right_siblings_same_inline_method?(node)) ||
            (inline_style? && access_modifier_is_not_inlined?(node))
        end

        def correctable_group_offense?(node)
          return false unless group_style?
          return false if allowed?(node)

          access_modifier_is_inlined?(node) && find_corresponding_def_nodes(node).any?
        end

        def group_style?
          style == :group
        end

        def inline_style?
          style == :inline
        end

        def access_modifier_is_inlined?(node)
          node.arguments.any?
        end

        def access_modifier_is_not_inlined?(node)
          !access_modifier_is_inlined?(node)
        end

        def right_siblings_same_inline_method?(node)
          node.right_siblings.any? do |sibling|
            sibling.send_type? &&
              correctable_group_offense?(sibling) &&
              sibling.method?(node.method_name) &&
              !sibling.arguments.empty? &&
              find_corresponding_def_nodes(sibling).any?
          end
        end

        def message(range)
          access_modifier = range.source

          if group_style?
            format(GROUP_STYLE_MESSAGE, access_modifier: access_modifier)
          elsif inline_style?
            format(INLINE_STYLE_MESSAGE, access_modifier: access_modifier)
          end
        end

        def find_corresponding_def_nodes(node)
          if access_modifier_with_symbol?(node)
            method_names = node.arguments.filter_map do |argument|
              next unless argument.sym_type?

              argument.respond_to?(:value) && argument.value
            end

            def_nodes = node.parent.each_child_node(:def).select do |child|
              method_names.include?(child.method_name)
            end

            # If there isn't a `def` node for each symbol, we will skip autocorrection.
            def_nodes.size == method_names.size ? def_nodes : []
          else
            [node.first_argument]
          end
        end

        def find_argument_less_modifier_node(node)
          return unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.each_child_node(:send).find do |child|
            child.method?(node.method_name) && child.arguments.empty?
          end
        end

        def select_grouped_def_nodes(node)
          node.right_siblings.take_while do |sibling|
            !(sibling.send_type? && sibling.bare_access_modifier_declaration?)
          end.select(&:def_type?)
        end

        def replace_defs(corrector, node, def_nodes)
          source = def_source(node, def_nodes)
          argument_less_modifier_node = find_argument_less_modifier_node(node)
          if argument_less_modifier_node
            corrector.insert_after(argument_less_modifier_node, "\n\n#{source}")
          elsif (ancestor = node.each_ancestor(:block, :class, :module).first)

            corrector.insert_before(ancestor.loc.end, "#{node.method_name}\n\n#{source}\n")
          else
            corrector.replace(node, "#{node.method_name}\n\n#{source}")
            return
          end

          remove_nodes(corrector, *def_nodes, node)
        end

        def insert_inline_modifier(corrector, node, modifier_name)
          corrector.insert_before(node, "#{modifier_name} ")
        end

        def remove_nodes(corrector, *nodes)
          nodes.each do |node|
            corrector.remove(range_with_comments_and_lines(node))
          end
        end

        def def_source(node, def_nodes)
          [
            *processed_source.ast_with_comments[node].map(&:text),
            *def_nodes.map(&:source)
          ].join("\n")
        end
      end
    end
  end
